logic.entry: Start cash; prior completed daily close strictly above mean of prior N completed closes*(1+0.01) enters desired-long state.
logic.exit: Prior close strictly below SMA*(1-0.01) exits desired-long; equality/deadband preserves desired state.
logic.sizing: At next UTC00:01 real minute open, buy maximum affordable LOT_SIZE floored quantity; keep leftover USDT. Sell all lot-valid held units when desired-cash or terminal. Failed orders do not change holdings and are retried at later daily decisions. No leverage, borrow, funding, transfers, rebalancing or USDT yield.

execution.simulation: Hypothetical immediately filled marketable LIMIT IOC at estimated adverse execution price, buy rounded up/sell down to PRICE_FILTER tick; quantity floored to LOT_SIZE. Check static price/quantity bounds and NOTIONAL. Fee paid in USDT; no fee discounts.
execution.percent_price: Check frozen PERCENT_PRICE_BY_SIDE against preceding5 fully closed minute quote-volume/base-volume VWAP proxy. Historical reference-price regime is unavailable; proxy is explicitly an assumption, not historical exchange order validation.
execution.limitations: Snapshot taken October1, applied uniformly to reused historical data as execution stress assumption, not historical filters. No L2, queue, latency, partial fills or guarantee IOC fills; MARKET_LOT_SIZE does not apply to simulated limit IOC.

logic.exit: While long, prior completed close strictly < mean of prior N completed daily closes * (1-band). Equality/deadband preserves state.
logic.sizing: All available component cash buys spot at next 00:01 UTC minute open, after costs; no leverage, borrowing, periodic rebalance or transfers. USDT yield=0.

logic.entry: Prior completed daily close > Decimal mean of prior N completed closes*(1.01) for Q consecutive OOS daily decisions sets desired-long.
logic.exit: Prior completed daily close < corresponding SMA*(0.99) for Q consecutive OOS daily decisions sets desired-cash. Each counter resets to0 when its strict inequality fails; equality/deadband resets counters but preserves desired holding.
logic.sizing: At next UTC00:01 real minute open, buy maximum affordable LOT_SIZE floored quantity; keep leftover USDT. Sell all lot-valid held units when desired-cash or terminal. Failed orders do not change holdings and are retried at later daily decisions. No leverage, borrow, funding, transfers, rebalancing or USDT yield.

execution.simulation: Hypothetical immediately filled marketable LIMIT IOC at estimated adverse execution price, buy rounded up/sell down to PRICE_FILTER tick; quantity floored to LOT_SIZE. Check static price/quantity bounds and NOTIONAL. Fee paid in USDT; no fee discounts.
execution.percent_price: Check frozen PERCENT_PRICE_BY_SIDE against preceding5 fully closed minute quote-volume/base-volume VWAP proxy. Historical reference-price regime is unavailable; proxy is explicitly an assumption, not historical exchange order validation.
execution.limitations: Snapshot taken October1, applied uniformly to reused historical data as execution stress assumption, not historical filters. No L2, queue, latency, partial fills or guarantee IOC fills; MARKET_LOT_SIZE does not apply to simulated limit IOC. Applied to2025 prices as a declared stress assumption; not claimed2025 historical exchange rules.

logic.entry: At decision i,use only prior completed daily closes. If lagged annualized20-return volatility<=annual_volatility_ceiling and priorclose strictly>SMA65*(1+entry_band_fraction),set desired-long.
logic.exit: If lagged annualized volatility>ceiling,set desired-cash immediately even during an uptrend.Otherwise priorclose strictly<SMA65*(1-exit_band_fraction) sets cash.Equality/deadband preserves desired.When volatility recovers,cash is not automatically restored to long;requires a valid above-entry crossing.No multi-day confirmation.
logic.sizing: At next UTC00:01 real minute open, buy maximum affordable LOT_SIZE floored quantity; keep leftover USDT. Sell all lot-valid held units when desired-cash or terminal. Failed orders do not change holdings and are retried at later daily decisions. No leverage, borrow, funding, transfers, rebalancing or USDT yield.

execution.simulation: Hypothetical immediately filled marketable LIMIT IOC at estimated adverse execution price, buy rounded up/sell down to PRICE_FILTER tick; quantity floored to LOT_SIZE. Check static price/quantity bounds and NOTIONAL. Fee paid in USDT; no fee discounts.
execution.percent_price: Check frozen PERCENT_PRICE_BY_SIDE against preceding5 fully closed minute quote-volume/base-volume VWAP proxy. Historical reference-price regime is unavailable; proxy is explicitly an assumption, not historical exchange order validation.
execution.limitations: Snapshot taken October1, applied uniformly to reused historical data as execution stress assumption, not historical filters. No L2, queue, latency, partial fills or guarantee IOC fills; MARKET_LOT_SIZE does not apply to simulated limit IOC. Applied to2025 prices as a declared stress assumption; not claimed2025 historical exchange rules.

logic.exit: Prior close C[i-1] strictly below min(C[i-exit_lookback_days-1:i-1]) sets desired-cash. Exit range contains exactly exit_lookback_days closes ending i-2. Equality or neither event preserves desired-state. No shorting,buffer,volatility filter,confirmation,stop or pyramiding.
logic.sizing: At next UTC00:01 real minute open, buy maximum affordable LOT_SIZE floored quantity; keep leftover USDT. Sell all lot-valid held units when desired-cash or terminal. Failed orders do not change holdings and are retried at later daily decisions. No leverage, borrow, funding, transfers, rebalancing or USDT yield.

execution.simulation: Hypothetical immediately filled marketable LIMIT IOC at estimated adverse execution price, buy rounded up/sell down to PRICE_FILTER tick; quantity floored to LOT_SIZE. Check static price/quantity bounds and NOTIONAL. Fee paid in USDT; no fee discounts.
execution.percent_price: Check frozen PERCENT_PRICE_BY_SIDE against preceding5 fully closed minute quote-volume/base-volume VWAP proxy. Historical reference-price regime is unavailable; proxy is explicitly an assumption, not historical exchange order validation.
execution.limitations: Snapshot taken October1, applied uniformly to reused historical data as execution stress assumption, not historical filters. No L2, queue, latency, partial fills or guarantee IOC fills; MARKET_LOT_SIZE does not apply to simulated limit IOC.

costs.impact_inputs: Previous20 completed UTC day quote ADV and sample stdev20 log daily returns. Buy cash before costs is conservative notional upper bound; sell uses units*reference. Decimal sqrt of budget/ADV, sigma/ADV derived from existing lagged daily function.

parameters.channel_definition: Decimal precision28 using daily CLOSE extrema only,not intraday highs/lows. Integer range widths include exactly L prior closes excluding tested prior close. All window timestamps end by i-2 daily completion;tested close available at UTC00:00 of decision day,trade reference next UTC00:01.

parameters.observation_terminal_action: Mark only; no artificial liquidation; preserve units/cash for continuing frozen plan
parameters.qualification: Partial shadow snapshot; minimum180days not reached; no long-run pass/fail inference

logic.rebalance: No transfers or rebalancing; component absolute NAVs already reflect their specified initial capital and all actual size-dependent costs.

parameters.observation_terminal_action: Mark only; no artificial liquidation; preserve underlying units/cash

logic.entry: While cash, prior completed close strictly > mean of prior N completed daily closes * (1+band).
logic.exit: While long, prior completed close strictly < mean of prior N completed daily closes * (1-band). Equality/deadband preserves state.
logic.sizing: All available component cash buys spot at next 00:01 UTC minute open, after costs; no leverage, borrowing, periodic rebalance or transfers. USDT yield=0.

costs.impact: 0.5 * strictly previous20completedUTCdays sample log-close volatility * sqrt(reference order upper-bound cash budget or sell reference notional / previous20day quote ADV)
costs.funding_borrow: Not applicable to unlevered long-only spot; no spot short or borrow.

logic.entry: While cash, prior completed close strictly > mean of prior N completed daily closes * (1+band).
logic.exit: While long, prior completed close strictly < mean of prior N completed daily closes * (1-band). Equality/deadband preserves state.
logic.sizing: All available component cash buys spot at next 00:01 UTC minute open, after costs; no leverage, borrowing, periodic rebalance or transfers. USDT yield=0.

costs.impact: 0.5 * strictly previous20completedUTCdays sample log-close volatility * sqrt(reference order upper-bound cash budget or sell reference notional / previous20day quote ADV)
costs.funding_borrow: Not applicable to unlevered long-only spot; no spot short or borrow.
costs.execution_limitations: Reuse existing daily floating-quantity accounting; no historical L2, tick/lot/min-notional or minute capacity calibration. Daily close NAV does not include full intraday drawdown.

logic.exit: While long, prior completed close strictly < mean of prior N completed daily closes * (1-band). Equality/deadband preserves state.

logic.entry: While cash, prior completed close strictly > mean of prior N completed daily closes * (1+band).
logic.exit: While long, prior completed close strictly < mean of prior N completed daily closes * (1-band). Equality/deadband preserves state.
logic.sizing: All available component cash buys spot at next 00:01 UTC minute open, after costs; no leverage, borrowing, periodic rebalance or transfers. USDT yield=0.

costs.impact: 0.5 * strictly previous20completedUTCdays sample log-close volatility * sqrt(reference order upper-bound cash budget or sell reference notional / previous20day quote ADV)
costs.funding_borrow: Not applicable to unlevered long-only spot; no spot short or borrow.
costs.execution_limitations: Reuse existing daily floating-quantity accounting; no historical L2, tick/lot/min-notional or minute capacity calibration. Daily close NAV does not include full intraday drawdown.

logic.exit: While long, prior completed close strictly < mean of prior N completed daily closes * (1-band). Equality/deadband preserves state.

logic.entry: While cash, prior completed close strictly > mean of prior N completed daily closes * (1+band).
logic.exit: While long, prior completed close strictly < mean of prior N completed daily closes * (1-band). Equality/deadband preserves state.
logic.sizing: All available component cash buys spot at next 00:01 UTC minute open, after costs; no leverage, borrowing, periodic rebalance or transfers. USDT yield=0.

costs.impact: 0.5 * strictly previous20completedUTCdays sample log-close volatility * sqrt(reference order upper-bound cash budget or sell reference notional / previous20day quote ADV)
costs.funding_borrow: Not applicable to unlevered long-only spot; no spot short or borrow.
costs.execution_limitations: Reuse existing daily floating-quantity accounting; no historical L2, tick/lot/min-notional or minute capacity calibration. Daily close NAV does not include full intraday drawdown.

logic.exit: While long, prior completed close strictly < mean of prior N completed daily closes * (1-band). Equality/deadband preserves state.

logic.entry: While cash, prior completed close strictly > mean of prior N completed daily closes * (1+band).
logic.exit: While long, prior completed close strictly < mean of prior N completed daily closes * (1-band). Equality/deadband preserves state.
logic.sizing: All available component cash buys spot at next 00:01 UTC minute open, after costs; no leverage, borrowing, periodic rebalance or transfers. USDT yield=0.

costs.impact: 0.5 * strictly previous20completedUTCdays sample log-close volatility * sqrt(reference order upper-bound cash budget or sell reference notional / previous20day quote ADV)
costs.funding_borrow: Not applicable to unlevered long-only spot; no spot short or borrow.
costs.execution_limitations: Reuse existing daily floating-quantity accounting; no historical L2, tick/lot/min-notional or minute capacity calibration. Daily close NAV does not include full intraday drawdown.

logic.exit: While long, prior completed close strictly < mean of prior N completed daily closes * (1-band). Equality/deadband preserves state.

logic.entry: While cash, prior completed close strictly > mean of prior N completed daily closes * (1+band).
logic.exit: While long, prior completed close strictly < mean of prior N completed daily closes * (1-band). Equality/deadband preserves state.
logic.sizing: All available component cash buys spot at next 00:01 UTC minute open, after costs; no leverage, borrowing, periodic rebalance or transfers. USDT yield=0.

costs.impact: 0.5 * strictly previous20completedUTCdays sample log-close volatility * sqrt(reference order upper-bound cash budget or sell reference notional / previous20day quote ADV)
costs.funding_borrow: Not applicable to unlevered long-only spot; no spot short or borrow.
costs.execution_limitations: Reuse existing daily floating-quantity accounting; no historical L2, tick/lot/min-notional or minute capacity calibration. Daily close NAV does not include full intraday drawdown.

logic.exit: While long, prior completed close strictly < mean of prior N completed daily closes * (1-band). Equality/deadband preserves state.

logic.entry: While cash, prior completed close strictly > mean of prior N completed daily closes * (1+band).
logic.exit: While long, prior completed close strictly < mean of prior N completed daily closes * (1-band). Equality/deadband preserves state.
logic.sizing: All available component cash buys spot at next 00:01 UTC minute open, after costs; no leverage, borrowing, periodic rebalance or transfers. USDT yield=0.

costs.impact: 0.5 * strictly previous20completedUTCdays sample log-close volatility * sqrt(reference order upper-bound cash budget or sell reference notional / previous20day quote ADV)
costs.funding_borrow: Not applicable to unlevered long-only spot; no spot short or borrow.
costs.execution_limitations: Reuse existing daily floating-quantity accounting; no historical L2, tick/lot/min-notional or minute capacity calibration. Daily close NAV does not include full intraday drawdown.

logic.exit: While long, prior completed close strictly < mean of prior N completed daily closes * (1-band). Equality/deadband preserves state.

logic.entry: At daily decision i,use completed prior close C[i-1]. Strictly above max(C[i-entry_lookback_days-1:i-1]) sets desired-long. The entry comparison range contains exactly entry_lookback_days completed closes ending i-2;it EXCLUDES the tested close i-1.
logic.exit: Prior close C[i-1] strictly below min(C[i-exit_lookback_days-1:i-1]) sets desired-cash. Exit range contains exactly exit_lookback_days closes ending i-2. Equality or neither event preserves desired-state. No shorting,buffer,volatility filter,confirmation,stop or pyramiding.
logic.sizing: At next UTC00:01 real minute open, buy maximum affordable LOT_SIZE floored quantity; keep leftover USDT. Sell all lot-valid held units when desired-cash or terminal. Failed orders do not change holdings and are retried at later daily decisions. No leverage, borrow, funding, transfers, rebalancing or USDT yield.

execution.simulation: Hypothetical immediately filled marketable LIMIT IOC at estimated adverse execution price, buy rounded up/sell down to PRICE_FILTER tick; quantity floored to LOT_SIZE. Check static price/quantity bounds and NOTIONAL. Fee paid in USDT; no fee discounts.
execution.percent_price: Check frozen PERCENT_PRICE_BY_SIDE against preceding5 fully closed minute quote-volume/base-volume VWAP proxy. Historical reference-price regime is unavailable; proxy is explicitly an assumption, not historical exchange order validation.
execution.limitations: Snapshot taken October1, applied uniformly to reused historical data as execution stress assumption, not historical filters. No L2, queue, latency, partial fills or guarantee IOC fills; MARKET_LOT_SIZE does not apply to simulated limit IOC. Applied to2025 prices as a declared stress assumption; not claimed2025 historical exchange rules.

logic.exit: If lagged annualized volatility>ceiling,set desired-cash immediately even during an uptrend.Otherwise priorclose strictly<SMA65*(1-exit_band_fraction) sets cash.Equality/deadband preserves desired.When volatility recovers,cash is not automatically restored to long;requires a valid above-entry crossing.No multi-day confirmation.
logic.sizing: At next UTC00:01 real minute open, buy maximum affordable LOT_SIZE floored quantity; keep leftover USDT. Sell all lot-valid held units when desired-cash or terminal. execution.simulation: Hypothetical immediately filled marketable LIMIT IOC at estimated adverse execution price, buy rounded up/sell down to PRICE_FILTER tick; quantity floored to LOT_SIZE. Check static price/quantity bounds and NOTIONAL. Fee paid in USDT; no fee discounts.

logic.entry: At daily decision i,use only completed prior close C[i-1]. It must strictly exceed max(C[i-16:i-1]) AND completed prior quote volume Q[i-1]>=minimum_volume_ratio*mean(Q[i-volume_lookback_days-1:i-1]),with positive reference mean,to set desired-long. Both reference ranges end i-2 and exclude the tested close/volume i-1. Quote volume is USDT turnover,not base units.
logic.exit: Prior close C[i-1] strictly below min(C[i-31:i-1]) sets desired-cash regardless of quote-volume eligibility. Exit takes precedence;otherwise eligible joint entry sets long;all other cases and price equality preserve desired. Low volume alone never forces liquidation. Volume equality at threshold qualifies. No delayed arming,extra confirmation,EMA,SMA,ATR,stop or shorting.
logic.state: Start OOS183 with cash and desired-cash. Historical closes/quote volumes only warm windows;no warmup fills/state replay. Carry cash,units,desired across six folds. Zero reference quote mean disables entry;no division by zero.
logic.sizing: At next UTC00:01 real minute open,buy maximum affordable LOT_SIZE quantity and keep residue;exit all valid units on desired cash/terminal. Existing Decimal28 PRICE/LOT/NOTIONAL/5minuteVWAP/participation execution with same1500USDT funds. No leverage,borrow,transfers,rebalancing or cash yield.

execution.simulation: Hypothetical immediately filled marketable LIMIT IOC at estimated adverse execution price, buy rounded up/sell down to PRICE_FILTER tick; quantity floored to LOT_SIZE. Check static price/quantity bounds and NOTIONAL. Fee paid in USDT; no fee discounts.
execution.percent_price: Check frozen PERCENT_PRICE_BY_SIDE against preceding5 fully closed minute quote-volume/base-volume VWAP proxy. Historical reference-price regime is unavailable; proxy is explicitly an assumption, not historical exchange order validation.
execution.limitations: Snapshot taken October1, applied uniformly to reused historical data as execution stress assumption, not historical filters. No L2, queue, latency, partial fills or guarantee IOC fills; MARKET_LOT_SIZE does not apply to simulated limit IOC. Applied to2025 prices as a declared stress assumption; not claimed2025 historical exchange rules.

costs.impact_inputs: Previous20 completed UTC day quote ADV and sample stdev20 log daily returns. Buy cash before costs is conservative notional upper bound; sell uses units*reference. Decimal sqrt of budget/ADV, sigma/ADV derived from existing lagged daily function.

parameters.channel_definition: Decimal precision28 using daily CLOSE extrema only,not intraday highs/lows. Integer range widths include exactly L prior closes excluding tested prior close. All window timestamps end by i-2 daily completion;tested close available at UTC00:00 of decision day,trade reference next UTC00:01.
parameters.signal_initialization: Cash/desired-cash at OOS183;only prior completed bars;carry across all folds;no warmup trades.
parameters.volume_definition: Prior fully completed UTC day USDT quote turnover divided by Decimal28 arithmetic mean of precedingN completed quote volumes excluding tested day. >=threshold eligible;reference mean>0;entry filter only,exit unfiltered.

logic.entry: At daily decision i,use only completed prior close C[i-1]. logic.entry: At daily decision i,use only completed prior close C[i-1]. It must strictly exceed max(C[i-16:i-1]) AND completed prior quote volume Q[i-1]>=minimum_volume_ratio*mean(Q[i-volume_lookback_days-1:i-1]),with positive reference mean,to set desired-long. Both reference ranges end i-2 and exclude the tested close/volume i-1. Quote volume is USDT turnover,not base units.
logic.exit: Prior close C[i-1] strictly below min(C[i-31:i-1]) sets desired-cash regardless of quote-volume eligibility. Exit takes precedence;otherwise eligible joint entry sets long;all other cases and price equality preserve desired. Low volume alone never forces liquidation. Volume equality at threshold qualifies. No delayed arming,extra confirmation,EMA,SMA,ATR,stop or shorting.
logic.state: Start OOS183 with cash and desired-cash. Historical closes/quote volumes only warm windows;no warmup fills/state replay. Carry cash,units,desired across six folds. Zero reference quote mean disables entry;no division by zero.
logic.sizing: At next UTC00:01 real minute open,buy maximum affordable LOT_SIZE quantity and keep residue;exit all valid units on desired cash/terminal. Existing Decimal28 PRICE/LOT/NOTIONAL/5minuteVWAP/participation execution with same500USDT funds. No leverage,borrow,transfers,rebalancing or cash yield.

execution.simulation: Hypothetical immediately filled marketable LIMIT IOC at estimated adverse execution price, buy rounded up/sell down to PRICE_FILTER tick; quantity floored to LOT_SIZE. Check static price/quantity bounds and NOTIONAL. Fee paid in USDT; no fee discounts.
execution.percent_price: Check frozen PERCENT_PRICE_BY_SIDE against preceding5 fully closed minute quote-volume/base-volume VWAP proxy. Historical reference-price regime is unavailable; proxy is explicitly an assumption, not historical exchange order validation.
execution.limitations: Snapshot taken October1, applied uniformly to reused historical data as execution stress assumption, not historical filters. No L2, queue, latency, partial fills or guarantee IOC fills; MARKET_LOT_SIZE does not apply to simulated limit IOC. Applied to2025 prices as a declared stress assumption; not claimed2025 historical exchange rules.

costs.impact_inputs: Previous20 completed UTC day quote ADV and sample stdev20 log daily returns. Buy cash before costs is conservative notional upper bound; sell uses units*reference. Decimal sqrt of budget/ADV, sigma/ADV derived from existing lagged daily function.

parameters.channel_definition: Decimal precision28 using daily CLOSE extrema only,not intraday highs/lows. Integer range widths include exactly L prior closes excluding tested prior close. All window timestamps end by i-2 daily completion;tested close available at UTC00:00 of decision day,trade reference next UTC00:01.
parameters.signal_initialization: Cash/desired-cash at OOS183;only prior completed bars;carry across all folds;no warmup trades.
parameters.volume_definition: Prior fully completed UTC day USDT quote turnover divided by Decimal28 arithmetic mean of precedingN completed quote volumes excluding tested day. >=threshold eligible;reference mean>0;entry filter only,exit unfiltered.

logic.entry: At daily decision i,use only completed prior close C[i-1]. It must strictly exceed max(C[i-16:i-1]) AND completed prior quote volume Q[i-1]>=minimum_volume_ratio*mean(Q[i-volume_lookback_days-1:i-1]),with positive reference mean,to set desired-long. Both reference ranges end i-2 and exclude the tested close/volume i-1. Quote volume is USDT turnover,not base units.
logic.exit: Prior close C[i-1] strictly below min(C[i-31:i-1]) sets desired-cash regardless of quote-volume eligibility. Exit takes precedence;otherwise eligible joint entry sets long;all other cases and price equality preserve desired. Low volume alone never forces liquidation. Volume equality at threshold qualifies. No delayed arming,extra confirmation,EMA,SMA,ATR,stop or shorting.
logic.state: Start OOS183 with cash and desired-cash. Historical closes/quote volumes only warm windows;no warmup fills/state replay. Carry cash,units,desired across six folds. Zero reference quote mean disables entry;no division by zero.
logic.sizing: At next UTC00:01 real minute open,buy maximum affordable LOT_SIZE quantity and keep residue;exit all valid units on desired cash/terminal. Existing Decimal28 PRICE/LOT/NOTIONAL/5minuteVWAP/participation execution with same500USDT funds. No leverage,borrow,transfers,rebalancing or cash yield.

parameters.channel_definition: Decimal precision28 using daily CLOSE extrema only,not intraday highs/lows. Integer range widths include exactly L prior closes excluding tested prior close. logic.EMA: alpha=2/(span+1);E[0]=float(first completed daily close),E[j]=(1-alpha)*E[j-1]+alpha*float(C[j]);Python float,adjust=False from datasetday0;never reset across folds.
logic.entry: At decision i, enter only when prior completed close C[i-1] strictly exceeds max(C[i-entry-1:i-1]) AND float(C[i-1])>EMA[i-1]*(1+band).The channel reference ends at i-2;no delayed arming memory.
logic.exit: Set desired cash when C[i-1]<min(C[i-exit-1:i-1]) OR float(C[i-1])<EMA[i-1]*(1-band).Exit takes precedence;otherwise joint entry sets long;all other cases/equality preserve desired.
logic.sizing: All affordable independent sleeve cash subject to Decimal28 tick/LOT/filter/participation and next00:01-minute IOC fill assumptions;no leverage,short,stop,scale-in or rebalance.
logic.state: OOS183 starts with cash and desired-cash;no pending entry or warmup position;daily decisions only using closes through i-1;no fit/labels/OOS tuning.

parameters.channel_definition: Decimal precision28 using daily CLOSE extrema only,not intraday highs/lows. Integer range widths include exactly L prior closes excluding tested prior close. All window timestamps end by i-2 daily completion;tested close available at UTC00:00 of decision day,trade reference next UTC00:01.

costs.impact_inputs: Previous20 completed UTC day quote ADV and sample stdev20 log daily returns. Buy cash before costs is conservative notional upper bound; sell uses units*reference. Decimal sqrt of budget/ADV, sigma/ADV derived from existing lagged daily function.

execution.limitations: Snapshot taken October1, applied uniformly to reused historical data as execution stress assumption, not historical filters. logic.EMA: alpha=2/(span+1);E[0]=float(first completed daily close),E[j]=(1-alpha)*E[j-1]+alpha*float(C[j]);Python float,adjust=False from datasetday0;never reset across folds.
logic.entry: At decision i, enter only when prior completed close C[i-1] strictly exceeds max(C[i-entry-1:i-1]) AND float(C[i-1])>EMA[i-1]*(1+band).The channel reference ends at i-2;no delayed arming memory.
logic.exit: Set desired cash when C[i-1]<min(C[i-exit-1:i-1]) OR float(C[i-1])<EMA[i-1]*(1-band).Exit takes precedence;otherwise joint entry sets long;all other cases/equality preserve desired.
logic.sizing: All affordable independent sleeve cash subject to Decimal28 tick/LOT/filter/participation and next00:01-minute IOC fill assumptions;no leverage,short,stop,scale-in or rebalance.
logic.state: OOS183 starts with cash and desired-cash;no pending entry or warmup position;daily decisions only using closes through i-1;no fit/labels/OOS tuning.

parameters.channel_definition: Decimal precision28 using daily CLOSE extrema only,not intraday highs/lows. Integer range widths include exactly L prior closes excluding tested prior close. All window timestamps end by i-2 daily completion;tested close available at UTC00:00 of decision day,trade reference next UTC00:01.

costs.impact_inputs: Previous20 completed UTC day quote ADV and sample stdev20 log daily returns. Buy cash before costs is conservative notional upper bound; sell uses units*reference. Decimal sqrt of budget/ADV, sigma/ADV derived from existing lagged daily function.

execution.limitations: Snapshot taken October1, applied uniformly to reused historical data as execution stress assumption, not historical filters. No L2, queue, latency, partial fills or guarantee IOC fills; MARKET_LOT_SIZE does not apply to simulated limit IOC. Applied to2025 prices as a declared stress assumption; not claimed2025 historical exchange rules.
execution.percent_price: Check frozen PERCENT_PRICE_BY_SIDE against preceding5 fully closed minute quote-volume/base-volume VWAP proxy. Historical reference-price regime is unavailable; proxy is explicitly an assumption, not historical exchange order validation.
execution.simulation: Hypothetical immediately filled marketable LIMIT IOC at estimated adverse execution price, buy rounded up/sell down to PRICE_FILTER tick; quantity floored to LOT_SIZE. Check static price/quantity bounds and NOTIONAL. Fee paid in USDT; no fee discounts.

parameters.signal_initialization: Desired cash at OOS183;warm prior max60+1 closes;state and actual cash/units carry across all six folds.No prefilled position or per-fold reset.

logic.execution: Actual observed bid/ask around mid,estimated slip/impact and fee simultaneously scaled1/2/3;adverse PRICE tick and LOT floor;independent original sleeve funds,no transfer/rebalance. All fills simulated at actual calculation timestamp after quotes/reservation;no historical fill price. Immediate full IOC is an assumption,not exchange acceptance.
logic.observation: First valid public quotes after reserve and before fixed capture deadline;actual timestamp retained,never selected from returns. Outcome is cumulative state plus this actual observation;short-window rejection never resets account.
logic.signals: Fixed asset-specific source rules in immutable plan SHA;latest closed UTC daily bar once,previous desired persists;no warmup fills

parameters.actual_cutoff_policy: Actual quote-snapshot evaluation time within this predeclared capture window;not a backfilled historical timestamp

logic.entry: At daily decision i,use only completed prior close C[i-1]. It must strictly exceed max(C[i-16:i-1]) AND completed prior quote volume Q[i-1]>=minimum_volume_ratio*mean(Q[i-volume_lookback_days-1:i-1]),with positive reference mean,to set desired-long. Both reference ranges end i-2 and exclude the tested close/volume i-1. Quote volume is USDT turnover,not base units.
logic.exit: Prior close C[i-1] strictly below min(C[i-31:i-1]) sets desired-cash regardless of quote-volume eligibility. Exit takes precedence;otherwise eligible joint entry sets long;all other cases and price equality preserve desired. Low volume alone never forces liquidation. Volume equality at threshold qualifies. No delayed arming,extra confirmation,EMA,SMA,ATR,stop or shorting.
logic.state: Start OOS183 with cash and desired-cash. Historical closes/quote volumes only warm windows;no warmup fills/state replay. Carry cash,units,desired across six folds. Zero reference quote mean disables entry;no division by zero.
logic.sizing: At next UTC00:01 real minute open,buy maximum affordable LOT_SIZE quantity and keep residue;exit all valid units on desired cash/terminal. Existing Decimal28 PRICE/LOT/NOTIONAL/5minuteVWAP/participation execution with same1200USDT funds. No leverage,borrow,transfers,rebalancing or cash yield.

execution.simulation: Hypothetical immediately filled marketable LIMIT IOC at estimated adverse execution price, buy rounded up/sell down to PRICE_FILTER tick; quantity floored to LOT_SIZE. Check static price/quantity bounds and NOTIONAL. Fee paid in USDT; no fee discounts.
execution.percent_price: Check frozen PERCENT_PRICE_BY_SIDE against preceding5 fully closed minute quote-volume/base-volume VWAP proxy. Historical reference-price regime is unavailable; proxy is explicitly an assumption, not historical exchange order validation.
execution.limitations: Snapshot taken October1, applied uniformly to reused historical data as execution stress assumption, not historical filters. No L2, queue, latency, partial fills or guarantee IOC fills; MARKET_LOT_SIZE does not apply to simulated limit IOC. Applied to2025 prices as a declared stress assumption; not claimed2025 historical exchange rules.

It must strictly exceed max(C[i-16:i-1]) AND completed prior quote volume Q[i-1]>=minimum_volume_ratio*mean(Q[i-volume_lookback_days-1:i-1]),with positive reference mean,to set desired-long. Both reference ranges end i-2 and exclude the tested close/volume i-1. Quote volume is USDT turnover,not base units.
logic.exit: Prior close C[i-1] strictly below min(C[i-31:i-1]) sets desired-cash regardless of quote-volume eligibility. Exit takes precedence;otherwise eligible joint entry sets long;all other cases and price equality preserve desired. Low volume alone never forces liquidation. Volume equality at threshold qualifies. No delayed arming,extra confirmation,EMA,SMA,ATR,stop or shorting.

logic.exit: Prior close C[i-1] strictly below min(C[i-31:i-1]) sets desired-cash regardless of quote-volume eligibility. Exit takes precedence;otherwise eligible joint entry sets long;all other cases and price equality preserve desired. Low volume alone never forces liquidation. Volume equality at threshold qualifies. No delayed arming,extra confirmation,EMA,SMA,ATR,stop or shorting.

logic.entry: At daily decision i,use only completed prior close C[i-1]. It must strictly exceed max(C[i-16:i-1]) AND completed prior quote volume Q[i-1]>=minimum_volume_ratio*mean(Q[i-volume_lookback_days-1:i-1]),with positive reference mean,to set desired-long. Both reference ranges end i-2 and exclude the tested close/volume i-1. Quote volume is USDT turnover,not base units.
logic.exit: Prior close C[i-1] strictly below min(C[i-21:i-1]) sets desired-cash regardless of quote-volume eligibility. Exit takes precedence;otherwise eligible joint entry sets long;all other cases and price equality preserve desired. Low volume alone never forces liquidation. Volume equality at threshold qualifies. No delayed arming,extra confirmation,EMA,SMA,ATR,stop or shorting.
logic.state: Start OOS183 with cash and desired-cash. Historical closes/quote volumes only warm windows;no warmup fills/state replay. Carry cash,units,desired across six folds. Zero reference quote mean disables entry;no division by zero.
logic.sizing: At next UTC00:01 real minute open,buy maximum affordable LOT_SIZE quantity and keep residue;exit all valid units on desired cash/terminal. Existing Decimal28 PRICE/LOT/NOTIONAL/5minuteVWAP/participation execution with same1100USDT funds. No leverage,borrow,transfers,rebalancing or cash yield.

execution.simulation: Hypothetical immediately filled marketable LIMIT IOC at estimated adverse execution price, buy rounded up/sell down to PRICE_FILTER tick; quantity floored to LOT_SIZE. Check static price/quantity bounds and NOTIONAL. Fee paid in USDT; no fee discounts.
execution.percent_price: Check frozen PERCENT_PRICE_BY_SIDE against preceding5 fully closed minute quote-volume/base-volume VWAP proxy. Historical reference-price regime is unavailable; proxy is explicitly an assumption, not historical exchange order validation.
execution.limitations: Snapshot taken October1, applied uniformly to reused historical data as execution stress assumption, not historical filters. No L2, queue, latency, partial fills or guarantee IOC fills; MARKET_LOT_SIZE does not apply to simulated limit IOC. Applied to2025 prices as a declared stress assumption; not claimed2025 historical exchange rules.

logic.entry: At daily decision i,use only completed prior close C[i-1]. It must strictly exceed max(C[i-11:i-1]) AND completed prior quote volume Q[i-1]>=minimum_volume_ratio*mean(Q[i-volume_lookback_days-1:i-1]),with positive reference mean,to set desired-long. Both reference ranges end i-2 and exclude the tested close/volume i-1. Quote volume is USDT turnover,not base units.
logic.exit: Prior close C[i-1] strictly below min(C[i-31:i-1]) sets desired-cash regardless of quote-volume eligibility. Exit takes precedence;otherwise eligible joint entry sets long;all other cases and price equality preserve desired. Low volume alone never forces liquidation. Volume equality at threshold qualifies. No delayed arming,extra confirmation,EMA,SMA,ATR,stop or shorting.
logic.state: Start OOS183 with cash and desired-cash. Historical closes/quote volumes only warm windows;no warmup fills/state replay. Carry cash,units,desired across six folds. Zero reference quote mean disables entry;no division by zero.
logic.sizing: At next UTC00:01 real minute open,buy maximum affordable LOT_SIZE quantity and keep residue;exit all valid units on desired cash/terminal. Existing Decimal28 PRICE/LOT/NOTIONAL/5minuteVWAP/participation execution with same1100USDT funds. No leverage,borrow,transfers,rebalancing or cash yield.

execution.simulation: Hypothetical immediately filled marketable LIMIT IOC at estimated adverse execution price, buy rounded up/sell down to PRICE_FILTER tick; quantity floored to LOT_SIZE. Check static price/quantity bounds and NOTIONAL. Fee paid in USDT; no fee discounts.
execution.percent_price: Check frozen PERCENT_PRICE_BY_SIDE against preceding5 fully closed minute quote-volume/base-volume VWAP proxy. Historical reference-price regime is unavailable; proxy is explicitly an assumption, not historical exchange order validation.
execution.limitations: Snapshot taken October1, applied uniformly to reused historical data as execution stress assumption, not historical filters. No L2, queue, latency, partial fills or guarantee IOC fills; MARKET_LOT_SIZE does not apply to simulated limit IOC. Applied to2025 prices as a declared stress assumption; not claimed2025 historical exchange rules.

logic.entry: At daily decision i,use only completed C[i-1]. logic.state: Start OOS183 with cash and desired-cash. Historical closes/quote volumes only warm windows;no warmup fills/state replay. Carry cash,units,desired across six folds. Zero reference quote mean disables entry;no division by zero.
logic.sizing: At next UTC00:01 real minute open,buy maximum affordable LOT_SIZE quantity and keep residue;exit all valid units on desired cash/terminal. costs.execution_limitations: Reuse existing daily floating-quantity accounting; no historical L2, tick/lot/min-notional or minute capacity calibration. Daily close NAV does not include full intraday drawdown.

logic.sizing: All available component cash buys spot at next 00:01 UTC minute open, after costs; no leverage, borrowing, periodic rebalance or transfers. USDT yield=0.

costs.impact: 0.5 * strictly previous20completedUTCdays sample log-close volatility * sqrt(reference order upper-bound cash budget or sell reference notional / previous20day quote ADV)
costs.funding_borrow: Not applicable to unlevered long-only spot; no spot short or borrow.
costs.execution_limitations: Reuse existing daily floating-quantity accounting; no historical L2, tick/lot/min-notional or minute capacity calibration. Daily close NAV does not include full intraday drawdown.

parameters.observation_terminal_action: Mark only; no artificial liquidation; preserve units/cash for continuing frozen plan
parameters.qualification: Partial shadow snapshot; minimum180days not reached; no long-run pass/fail inference

logic.EMA: alpha=2/(span+1);E[0]=float(first completed daily close),E[j]=(1-alpha)*E[j-1]+alpha*float(C[j]);Python float,adjust=False from datasetday0;never reset across folds.
logic.entry: At decision i, enter only when prior completed close C[i-1] strictly exceeds max(C[i-entry-1:i-1]) AND float(C[i-1])>EMA[i-1]*(1+band).The channel reference ends at i-2;no delayed arming memory.
logic.exit: Set desired cash when C[i-1]<min(C[i-exit-1:i-1]) OR float(C[i-1])<EMA[i-1]*(1-band).Exit takes precedence;otherwise joint entry sets long;all other cases/equality preserve desired.
logic.sizing: All affordable independent sleeve cash subject to Decimal28 tick/LOT/filter/participation and next00:01-minute IOC fill assumptions;no leverage,short,stop,scale-in or rebalance.
logic.state: OOS183 starts with cash and desired-cash;no pending entry or warmup position;daily decisions only using closes through i-1;no fit/labels/OOS tuning.

parameters.channel_definition: Decimal precision28 using daily CLOSE extrema only,not intraday highs/lows. Integer range widths include exactly L prior closes excluding tested prior close. All window timestamps end by i-2 daily completion;tested close available at UTC00:00 of decision day,trade reference next UTC00:01.

costs.impact_inputs: Previous20 completed UTC day quote ADV and sample stdev20 log daily returns. Buy cash before costs is conservative notional upper bound; sell uses units*reference. Decimal sqrt of budget/ADV, sigma/ADV derived from existing lagged daily function.

execution.limitations: Snapshot taken October1, applied uniformly to reused historical data as execution stress assumption, not historical filters. logic.EMA: alpha=2/(span+1);E[0]=float(first completed daily close),E[j]=(1-alpha)*E[j-1]+alpha*float(C[j]);Python float,adjust=False from datasetday0;never reset across folds.
logic.entry: At decision i,enter only if prior completed C[i-1]>max(C[i-16:i-1]) AND float(C[i-1])>EMA30[i-1]*(1+entry_band).Channel reference ends i-2,excludes tested close;both gates on same decision,no delayed arming.
logic.exit: Set desired-cash if C[i-1]<min(C[i-31:i-1]) OR float(C[i-1])<EMA30[i-1]*(1-exit_band).Exit priority;otherwise joint entry sets long;all other cases/equality preserve desired.Entry/exit bands independent.
logic.sizing: All affordable independent sleeve cash subject to Decimal28 tick/LOT/filter/participation and next00:01-minute IOC fill assumptions;no leverage,short,stop,scale-in or rebalance.
logic.state: OOS183 starts with cash and desired-cash;no pending entry or warmup position;daily decisions only using closes through i-1;no fit/labels/OOS tuning.

parameters.channel_definition: Decimal precision28 using daily CLOSE extrema only,not intraday highs/lows. Integer range widths include exactly L prior closes excluding tested prior close. costs.impact_inputs: Previous20 completed UTC day quote ADV and sample stdev20 log daily returns. Buy cash before costs is conservative notional upper bound; sell uses units*reference. Decimal sqrt of budget/ADV, sigma/ADV derived from existing lagged daily function.

execution.limitations: Snapshot taken October1, applied uniformly to reused historical data as execution stress assumption, not historical filters. logic.EMA: alpha=2/(span+1);E[0]=float(first completed daily close),E[j]=(1-alpha)*E[j-1]+alpha*float(C[j]);Python float,adjust=False from datasetday0;never reset across folds.
logic.entry: At decision i,enter only if prior completed C[i-1]>max(C[i-16:i-1]) AND float(C[i-1])>EMA[EMA_span_days][i-1]*(1+entry_band).Channel reference ends i-2,excludes tested close;both gates on same decision,no delayed arming.
logic.exit: Set desired-cash if C[i-1]<min(C[i-31:i-1]) OR float(C[i-1])<EMA[EMA_span_days][i-1]*(1-exit_band).Exit priority;otherwise joint entry sets long;all other cases/equality preserve desired.Entry/exit bands independent.
logic.sizing: All affordable independent sleeve cash subject to Decimal28 tick/LOT/filter/participation and next00:01-minute IOC fill assumptions;no leverage,short,stop,scale-in or rebalance.
logic.state: OOS183 starts with cash and desired-cash;no pending entry or warmup position;daily decisions only using closes through i-1;no fit/labels/OOS tuning.

parameters.channel_definition: Decimal precision28 using daily CLOSE extrema only,not intraday highs/lows. Integer range widths include exactly L prior closes excluding tested prior close. All window timestamps end by i-2 daily completion;tested close available at UTC00:00 of decision day,trade reference next UTC00:01.

costs.impact_inputs: Previous20 completed UTC day quote ADV and sample stdev20 log daily returns. Buy cash before costs is conservative notional upper bound; sell uses units*reference. Decimal sqrt of budget/ADV, sigma/ADV derived from existing lagged daily function.

execution.limitations: Snapshot taken October1, applied uniformly to reused historical data as execution stress assumption, not historical filters. No L2, queue, latency, partial fills or guarantee IOC fills; MARKET_LOT_SIZE does not apply to simulated limit IOC. Applied to2025 prices as a declared stress assumption; not claimed2025 historical exchange rules.

execution.simulation: Hypothetical immediately filled marketable LIMIT IOC at estimated adverse execution price, buy rounded up/sell down to PRICE_FILTER tick; quantity floored to LOT_SIZE. Check static price/quantity bounds and NOTIONAL. Fee paid in USDT; no fee discounts.

logic.EMA: alpha=2/(span+1);E[0]=float(first completed daily close),E[j]=(1-alpha)*E[j-1]+alpha*float(C[j]);Python float,adjust=False from datasetday0;never reset across folds.
logic.entry: At decision i,enter only if prior completed C[i-1]>max(C[i-16:i-1]) AND float(C[i-1])>EMA[EMA_span_days][i-1]*(1+entry_band).Channel reference ends i-2,excludes tested close;both gates on same decision,no delayed arming.
logic.exit: Set desired-cash if C[i-1]<min(C[i-31:i-1]) OR float(C[i-1])<EMA[EMA_span_days][i-1]*(1-exit_band).Exit priority;otherwise joint entry sets long;all other cases/equality preserve desired.Entry/exit bands independent.
logic.sizing: All affordable independent sleeve cash subject to Decimal28 tick/LOT/filter/participation and next00:01-minute IOC fill assumptions;no leverage,short,stop,scale-in or rebalance.
logic.state: OOS183 starts with cash and desired-cash;no pending entry or warmup position;daily decisions only using closes through i-1;no fit/labels/OOS tuning.

parameters.channel_definition: Decimal precision28 using daily CLOSE extrema only,not intraday highs/lows. Integer range widths include exactly L prior closes excluding tested prior close. All window timestamps end by i-2 daily completion;tested close available at UTC00:00 of decision day,trade reference next UTC00:01.

costs.impact_inputs: Previous20 completed UTC day quote ADV and sample stdev20 log daily returns. Buy cash before costs is conservative notional upper bound; sell uses units*reference. Decimal sqrt of budget/ADV, sigma/ADV derived from existing lagged daily function.

execution.limitations: Snapshot taken October1, applied uniformly to reused historical data as execution stress assumption, not historical filters. logic.entry: At a newly completed UTC daily bar i, enter long only when C[i-1] > arithmetic_mean(C[i-150:i]) * (1 + 0.00%); SMA uses the 150 most recent completed daily closes including C[i-1].
logic.exit: When long, exit when C[i-1] < arithmetic_mean(C[i-150:i]) * (1 - 0.00%); otherwise retain prior desired state. Equality and values inside the symmetric band retain state.
logic.sizing: Independent unlevered long-only spot account, initial capital 2000 USDT; buy maximum affordable quantity after signal close at next UTC day 00:01 one-minute open; preserve cash/units; terminal liquidation is costed. No pre-OOS fills, leverage, shorting, rebalancing, or cross-asset transfer.
logic.signal_timing: Daily input is closed UTC candles only; last closed signal is available before next-day 00:01 UTC execution.

logic.signal: For a completed UTC daily close i-1, compute each asset simple return C[i-1]/C[i-1-L]-1. Select the asset with the higher return (BTC breaks exact ties); set target cash unless the winning return is strictly above the configured absolute hurdle.
logic.rebalance: Trade only on target change. If rotating, sell held coin completely before buying the new leader using remaining cash; if threshold is not met, sell to cash. While desired asset is unchanged, do not rebalance. A failed leg remains in current cash/coin state and the next daily decision retries only if target still differs.
logic.timing: Signals use completed daily closes only. Trade at next UTC day 00:01 one-minute open after signal availability; terminal close is costed at the common endpoint.
logic.sizing: Independent $2,000 spot account, 100% one-asset-or-cash target, no simultaneous holdings, leverage, short, interest, cross-account transfers, or pre-OOS fills.

logic.ratio: x_j=ln(completed_close_BTC[j]/completed_close_ETH[j]). At signal j use sample mean/std of the prior L completed x values x[j-L:j]; exclude current x_j. z=(x_j-mean)/sample_std; if std==0 use 0.
logic.entry: When in cash, z>entry_zscore_threshold targets ETH (BTC relatively rich); z<-entry_zscore_threshold targets BTC (ETH relatively rich); else remain in cash. Boundaries are strict.
logic.exit_and_switch: While holding ETH, hold if z>0.5; exit to cash when z<=0.5; directly switch to BTC if z<-entry threshold. While holding BTC, hold if z<-0.5; exit when z>=-0.5; directly switch to ETH if z>entry threshold. Extreme opposite entry has priority. Trade only on target changes.
logic.timing: Use only completed UTC daily closes. Execute at next UTC day 00:01 one-minute open; a switch sells then buys at that same timestamp and charges both legs.
logic.sizing: Independent $2,000 long-only spot account, at most one coin held at a time or cash. No shorting, leverage, yield, transfer, or pre-OOS holding.

logic.exit_and_switch: While holding ETH, hold if z>0.5; exit to cash when z<=0.5; directly switch to BTC if z<-entry threshold. While holding BTC, hold if z<-0.5; exit when z>=-0.5; directly switch to ETH if z>entry threshold. Extreme opposite entry has priority. Trade only on target changes.
logic.timing: Use only completed UTC daily closes. Execute at next UTC day 00:01 one-minute open; a switch sells then buys at that same timestamp and charges both legs.
logic.sizing: Independent $2,000 long-only spot account, at most one coin held at a time or cash. No shorting, leverage, yield, transfer, or pre-OOS holding.

logic.entry: At a newly closed daily bar j, compute ROC_L=close[j]/close[j-L]-1. If flat, enter long only if ROC_L > entry_hurdle_fraction, strict inequality.
logic.exit: If long, exit when ROC_L <= 0. Otherwise preserve prior target state. Exit takes precedence if state is long; entry can only start from flat.
logic.sizing: Independent 2,000 USDT cash account; all original capital allocated to this asset; long-only, no leverage, no borrowing, no cross-asset transfer or add-on.
logic.timing: Close-based signal only from a closed UTC daily bar, next day 00:01 UTC one-minute open (60-second delay); no historical fill before OOS.

parameters.impact_model: 0.5 * sample_stdev(previous 20 complete UTC daily log returns) * sqrt(order quote budget / previous 20 complete daily quote-volume ADV)

logic.entry: On completed UTC daily barj, compute Decimal median of the lastL closed daily closes includingj; evenL averages the middle two. When flat, enter iff close[j]>median*(1+entry_hurdle_fraction), strict inequality.
logic.exit: When long, exit iff close[j]<median*(1-entry_hurdle_fraction), strict inequality. Equality/deadband preserves held/cash state. Only completed closes enter the median; no pending future data.
logic.sizing: Independent 2,000 USDT cash account; all original capital allocated to this asset; long-only, no leverage, no borrowing, no cross-asset transfer or add-on.
logic.timing: Close-based signal only from a closed UTC daily bar, next day 00:01 UTC one-minute open (60-second delay); no historical fill before OOS.

parameters.impact_model: 0.5 * sample_stdev(previous 20 complete UTC daily log returns) * sqrt(order quote budget / previous 20 complete daily quote-volume ADV)

logic.entry: Use lastL completed daily closes includingj. Forx=0..L-1,y=ln(close),fit intercept+slope by OLS. Sxx=sum((x-meanx)^2);beta=sum((x-meanx)*(y-meany))/Sxx;residual_sd=sqrt(sum((y-meany-beta*(x-meanx))^2)/(L-2));score=beta*sqrt(Sxx)/max(residual_sd,1e-12). Constant prices give0; floor handles degenerate perfect fits. Score is dimensionless and is not a calibrated significance test. When flat, enter iff score>entry_t_stat; equality remains cash.
logic.exit: When long, exit iff score<=exit_t_stat=0; otherwise remain long. All estimation uses only completed daily closes; no predictive labels, future observations or fitted hyperparameter selection.
logic.sizing: Independent 2,000 USDT cash account; all original capital allocated to this asset; long-only, no leverage, no borrowing, no cross-asset transfer or add-on.
logic.timing: Close-based signal only from a closed UTC daily bar, next day 00:01 UTC one-minute open (60-second delay); no historical fill before OOS.

logic.entry: Use lastL completed daily closes includingj. Forx=0..L-1,y=ln(close),fit intercept+slope by OLS. Sxx=sum((x-meanx)^2);beta=sum((x-meanx)*(y-meany))/Sxx;residual_sd=sqrt(sum((y-meany-beta*(x-meanx))^2)/(L-2));score=beta*sqrt(Sxx)/max(residual_sd,1e-12). Constant prices give0; floor handles degenerate perfect fits. Score is dimensionless and is not a calibrated significance test. When flat, enter iff score>entry_t_stat; equality remains cash.
logic.exit: When long, exit iff score<=exit_t_stat=0; otherwise remain long. All estimation uses only completed daily closes; no predictive labels, future observations or fitted hyperparameter selection.

logic.entry: From dataset day0 completed closes, seed average gain/loss with simple means of firstL close changes (first score at dayL). Thereafter avg_t=((L-1)*avg_previous+new_gain_or_loss)/L, Decimal28. RSI=100*avg_gain/(avg_gain+avg_loss); when both zero use50. No reset at OOS/fold boundaries. SMA200 includes the current completed signal close. While flat, enter iff RSI<entry_rsi and completed signal close>SMA(trend_sma_days), both strict.
logic.exit: While long, exit iff RSI>=exit_rsi=50 or completed signal close<=SMA(trend_sma_days). Exit precedence; no same-decision re-entry or predictive labels.

logic.entry: At completed signal barj, upper=max(close[j-L:j]) and lower=min(close[j-10:j]), both exclude current signal bar. Compare Decimal close[j] with these strictly lagged levels. Track only successful entry fills at their next-day00:01UTC execution time; age is (current decision execution time minus that entry time)/86400000. Failed entries do not start the clock; failed exits preserve the existing clock. While flat, enter iff close[j]>upper; equality remains cash.
logic.exit: While long, exit first when filled-position age>=max_holding_days, otherwise when close[j]<min(previous exit_lookback_days closes excludingj). Lower-bound equality holds before timeout. No same-decision re-entry; terminal liquidation remains costed.

logic.entry: From dataset day0 completed closes, seed average gain/loss with simple means of firstL close changes, first score at dayL. Thereafter avg_t=((L-1)*avg_previous+new_gain_or_loss)/L, Decimal28. RSI=100*avg_gain/(avg_gain+avg_loss); both zero use50. No OOS/fold resets or future values. When flat, enter iff RSI>entry_rsi; equality remains cash.
logic.exit: When long, exit iff RSI<exit_rsi=45; equality/deadband preserves actual long state. No SMA filter, time cap or same-decision re-entry; terminal liquidation stays costed.
logic.sizing: Independent 2,000 USDT cash account; all original capital allocated to this asset; long-only, no leverage, no borrowing, no cross-asset transfer or add-on.
logic.timing: Close-based signal only from a closed UTC daily bar, next day 00:01 UTC one-minute open (60-second delay); no historical fill before OOS.

parameters.impact_model: 0.5 * sample_stdev(previous 20 complete UTC daily log returns) * sqrt(order quote budget / previous 20 complete daily quote-volume ADV)

logic.entry: At fixed dataset day indexL-1 seed KAMA with the arithmetic mean of closes0..L-1. For j>=L,ER_j=abs(C_j-C_(j-L))/sum(k=j-L+1..j,abs(C_k-C_(k-1)));zero denominator meansER=0. SC_j=[ER_j*(2/(fast+1)-2/(slow+1))+2/(slow+1)]^2. KAMA_j=KAMA_(j-1)+SC_j*(C_j-KAMA_(j-1)),Decimal28. Fast=2. No OOS/fold resets. When flat, enter iff completed close>KAMA*1.01; strict boundary, no prior-cross requirement.
logic.exit: While long, exit iff completed close<KAMA*0.99; equality and inside-band preserve actual held/cash state. No future inputs, fold reset, short position, hold cap or same-decision re-entry. Costed terminal liquidation.

logic.entry: Aggregate UTC daily high=max(all1440 closed minute highs),low=min(all1440 closed minute lows). At completed dayj use j-N..j inclusive(N+1daily ranges). For equal extrema choose most recent day. ah=j-index_high,al=j-index_low. Up=100*(N-ah)/N,Down=100*(N-al)/N,osc=Up-Down,Decimal28. First valid indexN;no future padding or fold reset. When flat, enter iff oscillator>entry_oscillator_threshold; strict boundary,no prior-cross requirement.
logic.exit: While long, exit iff oscillator<0. Zero preserves long; flat stays cash at or below entry threshold. No future padding, fold reset, short, hold cap or same-decision re-entry. Costed terminal liquidation.

logic.entry: Use UTC daily high/low extrema and final close from1440completed minute bars. TP=(H+L+C)/3;CCI=(TP_j-mean(TP,N))/(0.015*mean(abs(TP-meanTP),N)),window j-N+1..j. Zero mean deviation=>CCI0. To avoid division-rounding decisions,let X=H+L+C,S=sumX,r_i=N*X_i-S,num=200*N*r_j,den=3*sum(abs(r_i));CCI=num/den. Compare num>E*den for entry and num<0 for exit using unrounded Decimal28 factors;save displayed CCI rounded only by Decimal division. No seed/fold reset. When flat,enter iff num>entry_cci_threshold*den;strict comparison,no prior-cross requirement.
logic.exit: While long,exit iff num<0. ZeroCCI/zero deviation preserve long;flat stays cash at or below entry threshold. No future padding,fold reset,short,hold cap or same-decision re-entry. Costed terminal liquidation.

logic.entry: Aggregate UTC daily high/low,last close and base volume over1440closed minutes. TP=(H+L+C)/3. Raw flow=TP*base_volume;assign to positive ifTP rises,negative ifTP falls,zero to both whenTP ties. Sum Nflows overj-N+1..j,using earlierTP atj-N. MFI=100*positive/(positive+negative);if total exactly0,set50. For exact thresholds use TP3=H+L+C,flow3=TP3*volume,which cancels the common3. Local Decimal60 flow arithmetic and cross-multiplied thresholds;accounting kernel remainsDecimal28. No seed/fold reset. When flat,enter iff MFI>entry_mfi_threshold;strict cross-multiplied comparison,no prior-cross requirement.
logic.exit: While long,exit iff MFI<45. Exact45and zero-flow-neutral50keep long;flat stays cash at or below entry threshold. No future padding,fold reset,short,hold cap or same-decision re-entry. Costed terminal liquidation.
logic.sizing: Independent 2,000 USDT cash account; all original capital allocated to this asset; long-only, no leverage, no borrowing, no cross-asset transfer or add-on.

logic.entry: On each completed UTC signal dayj, VWMA_L=sum(C_i*V_i)/sum(V_i),i=j-L+1..j,includingj;C is last closed minute close,V is sum of1440closed-minute base-asset volumes. Exact Fraction from daily Float64decimal strings,canonical ratioSHA,Decimal60display only. NeedLclosed days,no padding. If window volume iszero,preserve actual position without a trade. When flat,enter iff close>VWMA*(1+entry_hurdle_fraction),strict.
logic.exit: When actually long,exit iff C_j<VWMA_L*(1-b),strict;equality/deadband preserves position. No short,leverage,add-on,transfer,cash interest or same-decision reentry;costed terminal liquidation.
logic.sizing: Independent 2,000 USDT cash account; all original capital allocated to this asset; long-only, no leverage, no borrowing, no cross-asset transfer or add-on.

logic.entry: At decision i,use only prior completed daily closes. If lagged annualized20-return volatility<=annual_volatility_ceiling and priorclose strictly>SMA65*(1+entry_band_fraction),set desired-long.
logic.exit: If lagged annualized volatility>ceiling,set desired-cash immediately even during an uptrend.Otherwise priorclose strictly<SMA65*(1-exit_band_fraction) sets cash.Equality/deadband preserves desired.When volatility recovers,cash is not automatically restored to long;requires a valid above-entry crossing.No multi-day confirmation.
logic.sizing: At next UTC00:01 real minute open, buy maximum affordable LOT_SIZE floored quantity; keep leftover USDT. Sell all lot-valid held units when desired-cash or terminal. Failed orders do not change holdings and are retried at later daily decisions. No leverage, borrow, funding, transfers, rebalancing or USDT yield.

costs.impact_inputs: Previous20 completed UTC day quote ADV and sample stdev20 log daily returns. Buy cash before costs is conservative notional upper bound; sell uses units*reference. Decimal sqrt of budget/ADV, sigma/ADV derived from existing lagged daily function.

execution.limitations: Snapshot taken October1, applied uniformly to reused historical data as execution stress assumption, not historical filters. No L2, queue, latency, partial fills or guarantee IOC fills; MARKET_LOT_SIZE does not apply to simulated limit IOC.
execution.percent_price: Check frozen PERCENT_PRICE_BY_SIDE against preceding5 fully closed minute quote-volume/base-volume VWAP proxy. Historical reference-price regime is unavailable; proxy is explicitly an assumption, not historical exchange order validation.
execution.simulation: Hypothetical immediately filled marketable LIMIT IOC at estimated adverse execution price, buy rounded up/sell down to PRICE_FILTER tick; quantity floored to LOT_SIZE. Check static price/quantity bounds and NOTIONAL. Fee paid in USDT; no fee discounts.

logic.signal: At completed UTC day j=i-1,absoluteROC_a=C_a[j]/C_a[j-L]-1;rankROC_a=C_a[j-S]/C_a[j-S-L]-1. Only assets with current absoluteROC>0 eligible. Select highest rankROC among eligible;BTC priority on exact tie.
logic.schedule: Only Mondays at next00:01UTC;no initial off-schedule buy. Other days keep actual holding,do not exit on new signals. Calendar from UTC date,not fold offsets.
logic.switching: If incumbent is eligible,retain it unless another eligible asset rankROC strictly exceeds incumbent rankROC by G. If incumbent ineligible,select best eligible without switching hurdle,or cash if none. Equality retains incumbent. S=0 is contemporaneous rank;S=7 skips exactly seven completed days in ranking,while cash gate always uses current absoluteROC.
logic.execution: On target change,sell all held coin before buying target at same declared next00:01 nativeDecimalOPEN. Both real legs charged separately;rejected sale prevents purchase. Quantity-rounding residue remains shared cash. No trade if target stays same.
logic.allocation: One shared2000USDT spot cash account;at most one BTC or ETH holding with raw target exposure1,other0. No75/25normalization,fixed-sleeve NAV sum,cashyield,borrowing,leverage,short or external transfers. Original frozen75/25SMA account unchanged.
logic.state: One cold cash start;carry actual cash,held asset,units across all12folds. No independent old component NAV can represent stateful shared-cash rotations,so actual new fill paths required.

execution.simulation: Hypothetical immediately filled marketable LIMIT IOC at estimated adverse execution price, buy rounded up/sell down to PRICE_FILTER tick; quantity floored to LOT_SIZE. Check static price/quantity bounds and NOTIONAL. Fee paid in USDT; no fee discounts.
execution.percent_price: Check frozen PERCENT_PRICE_BY_SIDE against preceding5 fully closed minute quote-volume/base-volume VWAP proxy. Historical reference-price regime is unavailable; proxy is explicitly an assumption, not historical exchange order validation.
execution.limitations: Snapshot taken October1, applied uniformly to reused historical data as execution stress assumption, not historical filters. No L2, queue, latency, partial fills or guarantee IOC fills; MARKET_LOT_SIZE does not apply to simulated limit IOC.

logic.frozen_recovery: On actual filled entry at indexe,freeze pre-shock anchorA=C[e-4] and signal closeB=C[e-1]. Hold until a completed close satisfies2*C[j]>=A+B (half arithmetic price recovery),or i-e>=H complete daily execution intervals. No re-anchoring or moving target.
logic.exit: Check exits only when held at decision start;exit at next00:01OPEN,never at an intraday target or old close. An exit decision cannot reenter the same day,even if the current3dayloss still qualifies. Earliest reentry next daily decision.
logic.state: One cold cash start per configuration;carry actual cash/units,entry index,A/B across all12folds. Successful sell clears state;rejected order leaves actual state unchanged. No stop,averaging down,pyramiding or fold reset.
logic.allocation: Each config independent2000USDT in one spot asset. Raw maximum asset exposure1 via affordable lot,cash residue retained. No portfolio weighting/normalization,transfers,leverage,short,borrowing or cash yield. Original ongoingSMA75/25 unchanged.
logic.terminal: OOSend is known in advance;allow normal late entries then costed terminal liquidation. Terminal truncation and entry index disclosed,not filtered using future outcome.

execution.simulation: Hypothetical immediately filled marketable LIMIT IOC at estimated adverse execution price, buy rounded up/sell down to PRICE_FILTER tick; quantity floored to LOT_SIZE. Check static price/quantity bounds and NOTIONAL. Fee paid in USDT; no fee discounts.
execution.percent_price: Check frozen PERCENT_PRICE_BY_SIDE against preceding5 fully closed minute quote-volume/base-volume VWAP proxy. Historical reference-price regime is unavailable; proxy is explicitly an assumption, not historical exchange order validation.
execution.limitations: Snapshot taken October1, applied uniformly to reused historical data as execution stress assumption, not historical filters. No L2, queue, latency, partial fills or guarantee IOC fills; MARKET_LOT_SIZE does not apply to simulated limit IOC.

costs.impact_inputs: Previous20 completed UTC day quote ADV and sample stdev20 log daily returns. Buy cash before costs is conservative notional upper bound; sell uses units*reference. Decimal sqrt of budget/ADV, sigma/ADV derived from existing lagged daily function.

logic.signal: At daily decision i,only previous fully closed perpetual UTCday j=i-1;ROC=C[j]/C[j-L]-1. Strict ROC>H meanslong,+1;ROC<-H meansshort,-1;otherwiseflat,including exact equality. No fitted parameters,funding predictor or mark-price signal.
logic.execution: At next00:01nativeperpetualOPEN,if desired direction differs,close old signed position first then enter desired if nonzero. Same direction retains actual quantity,no daily resizing. Quantity for a new entry=floor(2000USDT/priorcompletedC/lot)*lot times direction,not sized from future OPEN,NAV or unpublished funding.
logic.allocation: Independent10000USDT collateral account per config. Fixed raw entry notional20% of initial collateral=2000USDT;pricegap/lot can change actual entry percentage. At most one signedlinearUSDTperp position;entrynotional<=postfeecollateral (1xcap). No borrowingunderlying,spotshort,leveragefundingloan,transfer or cashyield;not normalized weights.
logic.ledger: Opening debitsfeeonly;unrealizedPnL=q*(price-entryexecution). Closing realizes signedq*(exitexecution-entryexecution) and paysfee. Notional is not debited as spot cash.
logic.funding: At actual settlementns,rawcashdelta=-signedq*actualmark*realizedrate. Only oldposition thenheld participates;funding events00:00/00:00.001 occur before00:01rotation. Negative delta multiplied by coststress;positive income not increased. Sourceavailable_ts (often+1hour) retained;rates are ex-post accounting only,never signal or size inputs.
logic.risk: Composite sampled NAV includes minute transaction-close proxies plus actual closed-hour mark and actualfundingsettlement marks,pre/posttrade samples and terminalcash. Report mark-only and trade-proxy DD separately. Marginproxy:1%ofnotional versus adverse full-hour markhigh/low for every overlapping state in completelyin-OOSclosedhours. No exact historicaltier/tick liquidation engine;anyproxybreachfails qualification.
logic.state: One cold collateral start across11continuous30dayfolds;carrycash/signedq/entryexecution/refandfunding. Known terminalcostedclose;no fold resets. OriginalSMA/paper10states unchanged.

logic.allocation: Raw weights1/1 mean one whole pre-funded10000USDT BTCbook plus one whole10000USDT ETHbook,total20000. Add absoluteNAV once;do not normalize,multiply by50%again,transfer,reinvestorrebalance. Descriptiveinitialcapitalshares50/50 do not change raw weights.

logic.reuse: Recover source fullNAV from savedimmutable signedcash/quantity/entry state segments and actual axis prices,verify every originalNAVSHA. Never call source simulate,trade,funding or signal functions;no old result/status rewriting.
logic.alignment: Unionof source (actualns,eventtype) keys;preserveeventorder atsametime. Atmissingotherassetkey carry its last completed sourceNAVobservation,never interpolate or lookahead. Relativekey=(ts-commonstart)*16+eventcode avoids epochint64overflow.
logic.costs: Source1/2/3xexecutionandnegativefundingoutflowstress inherited in actualmatchedcostpaths;positivefundingincomeunscaled. Sum actual fees/funding once,no portfolio turnover fees since no new trade.
logic.risk: Recompute return/Sharpe/Calmar/wholeOOSDDfrom combinedfullcurve,not average components. Check both originalindependentmarginproxies separately;never offset a failed sleeve with othercash. MixedsampledNAV nottruetickmarkrisk.

logic.signal: At daily decision i,priorcompletedperpetualROC=C[i-1]/C[i-1-L]-1. Flat enterslong iff ROC>H,short iff ROC<-H. Existinglong persistswhile ROC>0;existingshort persistswhile ROC<0. At ROC=0 exit. OppositeROC crossingfullentryband closesoldthenentersopposite at00:01. At exact +/-H no newentry;an existing same-sign position remains. State is actualsignedquantity,no unpublishedprice/funding input.
logic.execution: At next00:01nativeperpetualOPEN,if desired direction differs,close old signed position first then enter desired if nonzero. Same direction retains actual quantity,no daily resizing. logic.signal: At daily decision i,priorcompletedperpetualROC=C[i-1]/C[i-1-L]-1. Flat enterslong iff ROC>H,short iff ROC<-H. Existinglong persistswhile ROC>0;existingshort persistswhile ROC<0. At ROC=0 exit. OppositeROC crossingfullentryband closesoldthenentersopposite at00:01. At exact +/-H no newentry;an existing same-sign position remains. State is actualsignedquantity,no unpublishedprice/funding input.
logic.execution: At next00:01nativeperpetualOPEN,if desired direction differs,close old signed position first then enter desired if nonzero. Same direction retains actual quantity,no daily resizing. Quantity for a new entry=floor(2000USDT/priorcompletedC/lot)*lot times direction,not sized from future OPEN,NAV or unpublished funding.
logic.allocation: Independent10000USDT collateral account per config. Fixed raw entry notional20% of initial collateral=2000USDT;pricegap/lot can change actual entry percentage. At most one signedlinearUSDTperp position;entrynotional<=postfeecollateral (1xcap). No borrowingunderlying,spotshort,leveragefundingloan,transfer or cashyield;not normalized weights.
logic.ledger: Opening debitsfeeonly;unrealizedPnL=q*(price-entryexecution). Closing realizes signedq*(exitexecution-entryexecution) and paysfee. Notional is not debited as spot cash.
logic.funding: At actual settlementns,rawcashdelta=-signedq*actualmark*realizedrate. Only oldposition thenheld participates;funding events00:00/00:00.001 occur before00:01rotation. Negative delta multiplied by coststress;positive income not increased. Sourceavailable_ts (often+1hour) retained;rates are ex-post accounting only,never signal or size inputs.
logic.risk: Composite sampled NAV includes minute transaction-close proxies plus actual closed-hour mark and actualfundingsettlement marks,pre/posttrade samples and terminalcash. Report mark-only and trade-proxy DD separately. Marginproxy:1%ofnotional versus adverse full-hour markhigh/low for every overlapping state in completelyin-OOSclosedhours. No exact historicaltier/tick liquidation engine;anyproxybreachfails qualification.
logic.state: One cold collateral start across11continuous30dayfolds;carrycash/signedq/entryexecution/refandfunding. Known terminalcostedclose;no fold resets. OriginalSMA/paper10states unchanged.

logic.entry: While cash, prior completed close strictly > mean of prior N completed daily closes * (1+band).
logic.exit: While long, prior completed close strictly < mean of prior N completed daily closes * (1-band). Equality/deadband preserves state.
logic.sizing: All available component cash buys spot at next 00:01 UTC minute open, after costs; no leverage, borrowing, periodic rebalance or transfers. USDT yield=0.

costs.impact: 0.5 * strictly previous20completedUTCdays sample log-close volatility * sqrt(reference order upper-bound cash budget or sell reference notional / previous20day quote ADV)
costs.funding_borrow: Not applicable to unlevered long-only spot; no spot short or borrow.
costs.execution_limitations: Reuse existing daily floating-quantity accounting; no historical L2, tick/lot/min-notional or minute capacity calibration. Daily close NAV does not include full intraday drawdown.

logic.execution: Actual observed bid/ask around mid,estimated slip/impact and fee simultaneously scaled1/2/3;adverse PRICE tick and LOT floor;independent original sleeve funds,no transfer/rebalance. All fills simulated at actual calculation timestamp after quotes/reservation;no historical fill price. Immediate full IOC is an assumption,not exchange acceptance.
logic.observation: First valid public quotes after reserve and before fixed capture deadline;actual timestamp retained,never selected from returns. Outcome is cumulative state plus this actual observation;short-window rejection never resets account.
logic.signals: Fixed asset-specific source rules in immutable plan SHA;latest closed UTC daily bar once,previous desired persists;no warmup fills

parameters.actual_cutoff_policy: Actual quote-snapshot evaluation time within this predeclared capture window;not a backfilled historical timestamp

logic.allocation: Raw weights1/1 mean one whole pre-funded10000USDT BTCbook plus one whole10000USDT ETHbook,total20000. Add absoluteNAV once;do not normalize,multiply by50%again,transfer,reinvestorrebalance. Descriptiveinitialcapitalshares50/50 do not change raw weights.
logic.exposure: Each sourceentry fixed2000USDT from priorclose;both sleeves grossentrynotional4000whenactive,20%ofcombinedinitialcollateral. Eachcash/marginaccountisolated,nocross-marginnettingorborrow/cashyield.
logic.reuse: Recover source fullNAV from savedimmutable signedcash/quantity/entry state segments and actual axis prices,verify every originalNAVSHA. Never call source simulate,trade,funding or signal functions;no old result/status rewriting.
logic.alignment: Unionof source (actualns,eventtype) keys;preserveeventorder atsametime. Atmissingotherassetkey carry its last completed sourceNAVobservation,never interpolate or lookahead. Relativekey=(ts-commonstart)*16+eventcode avoids epochint64overflow.
logic.costs: Source1/2/3xexecutionandnegativefundingoutflowstress inherited in actualmatchedcostpaths;positivefundingincomeunscaled. Sum actual fees/funding once,no portfolio turnover fees since no new trade.
logic.risk: Recompute return/Sharpe/Calmar/wholeOOSDDfrom combinedfullcurve,not average components. Check both originalindependentmarginproxies separately;never offset a failed sleeve with othercash. MixedsampledNAV nottruetickmarkrisk.

logic.signal: At daily decision i,priorcompletedperpetualROC=C[i-1]/C[i-1-L]-1. Flat enterslong iff ROC>H,short iff ROC<-H. Inside or on entrybands,existinglong persists strictly while ROC>-E;existingshort persists strictly while ROC<E. Long exits at ROC<=-E;short exits at ROC>=E. Crossing opposite strict fullentryband closesold then opensopposite at00:01. E<=H,at exact +/-H no newentry. State is actualsignedquantity,no unpublishedprice/funding input.
logic.execution: At next00:01nativeperpetualOPEN,if desired direction differs,close old signed position first then enter desired if nonzero. Same direction retains actual quantity,no daily resizing. Quantity for a new entry=floor(2000USDT/priorcompletedC/lot)*lot times direction,not sized from future OPEN,NAV or unpublished funding.
logic.allocation: Independent10000USDT collateral account per config. Fixed raw entry notional20% of initial collateral=2000USDT;pricegap/lot can change actual entry percentage. At most one signedlinearUSDTperp position;entrynotional<=postfeecollateral (1xcap). No borrowingunderlying,spotshort,leveragefundingloan,transfer or cashyield;not normalized weights.
logic.ledger: Opening debitsfeeonly;unrealizedPnL=q*(price-entryexecution). Closing realizes signedq*(exitexecution-entryexecution) and paysfee. Notional is not debited as spot cash.
logic.funding: At actual settlementns,rawcashdelta=-signedq*actualmark*realizedrate. Only oldposition thenheld participates;funding events00:00/00:00.001 occur before00:01rotation. Negative delta multiplied by coststress;positive income not increased. Sourceavailable_ts (often+1hour) retained;rates are ex-post accounting only,never signal or size inputs.
logic.risk: Composite sampled NAV includes minute transaction-close proxies plus actual closed-hour mark and actualfundingsettlement marks,pre/posttrade samples and terminalcash. Report mark-only and trade-proxy DD separately. Marginproxy:1%ofnotional versus adverse full-hour markhigh/low for every overlapping state in completelyin-OOSclosedhours. No exact historicaltier/tick liquidation engine;anyproxybreachfails qualification.
logic.state: One cold collateral start across11continuous30dayfolds;carrycash/signedq/entryexecution/refandfunding. Known terminalcostedclose;no fold resets. OriginalSMA/paper10states unchanged.

costs.impact: 0.5*sampledailylogvol20*sqrt(abs(orderquantity)*nativeOPEN/prior20fullperpdayquoteADV)
costs.fee_provenance: Frozen5bp perpetual assumption matches existing20261001T053425Z/carry.py;not a claim of historicalVIPfee schedule.

parameters.persistence: Keep actual long while ROC>-E or short while ROC<E inside entrybands;strict entrybands have priority,unchanged quantity.

logic.entry: While cash, prior completed close strictly > mean of prior N completed daily closes * (1+band).
logic.exit: While long, prior completed close strictly < mean of prior N completed daily closes * (1-band). Equality/deadband preserves state.
logic.sizing: All available component cash buys spot at next 00:01 UTC minute open, after costs; no leverage, borrowing, periodic rebalance or transfers. USDT yield=0.

costs.impact: 0.5 * strictly previous20completedUTCdays sample log-close volatility * sqrt(reference order upper-bound cash budget or sell reference notional / previous20day quote ADV)
costs.funding_borrow: Not applicable to unlevered long-only spot; no spot short or borrow.
costs.execution_limitations: Reuse existing daily floating-quantity accounting; no historical L2, tick/lot/min-notional or minute capacity calibration. Daily close NAV does not include full intraday drawdown.
