logic.signal: At daily decision i,priorcompletedperpetualROC=C[i-1]/C[i-1-L]-1. Flat enterslong iff ROC>H,short iff ROC<-H. Existinglong persistswhile ROC>0;existingshort persistswhile ROC<0. At ROC=0 exit. OppositeROC crossingfullentryband closesoldthenentersopposite at00:01. At exact +/-H no newentry;an existing same-sign position remains. State is actualsignedquantity,no unpublishedprice/funding input.
logic.execution: At next00:01nativeperpetualOPEN,if desired direction differs,close old signed position first then enter desired if nonzero. Same direction retains actual quantity,no daily resizing. Quantity for a new entry=floor(2000USDT/priorcompletedC/lot)*lot times direction,not sized from future OPEN,NAV or unpublished funding.
logic.allocation: Independent10000USDT collateral account per config. Fixed raw entry notional20% of initial collateral=2000USDT;pricegap/lot can change actual entry percentage. At most one signedlinearUSDTperp position;entrynotional<=postfeecollateral (1xcap). No borrowingunderlying,spotshort,leveragefundingloan,transfer or cashyield;not normalized weights.
logic.ledger: Opening debitsfeeonly;unrealizedPnL=q*(price-entryexecution). Closing realizes signedq*(exitexecution-entryexecution) and paysfee. Notional is not debited as spot cash.
logic.funding: At actual settlementns,rawcashdelta=-signedq*actualmark*realizedrate. Only oldposition thenheld participates;funding events00:00/00:00.001 occur before00:01rotation. Negative delta multiplied by coststress;positive income not increased. Sourceavailable_ts (often+1hour) retained;rates are ex-post accounting only,never signal or size inputs.
logic.risk: Composite sampled NAV includes minute transaction-close proxies plus actual closed-hour mark and actualfundingsettlement marks,pre/posttrade samples and terminalcash. Report mark-only and trade-proxy DD separately. Marginproxy:1%ofnotional versus adverse full-hour markhigh/low for every overlapping state in completelyin-OOSclosedhours. No exact historicaltier/tick liquidation engine;anyproxybreachfails qualification.
logic.state: One cold collateral start across11continuous30dayfolds;carrycash/signedq/entryexecution/refandfunding. Known terminalcostedclose;no fold resets. OriginalSMA/paper10states unchanged.

logic.entry: While cash, prior completed close strictly > mean of prior N completed daily closes * (1+band).
logic.exit: While long, prior completed close strictly < mean of prior N completed daily closes * (1-band). Equality/deadband preserves state.
logic.sizing: All available component cash buys spot at next 00:01 UTC minute open, after costs; no leverage, borrowing, periodic rebalance or transfers. USDT yield=0.

costs.impact: 0.5 * strictly previous20completedUTCdays sample log-close volatility * sqrt(reference order upper-bound cash budget or sell reference notional / previous20day quote ADV)
costs.funding_borrow: Not applicable to unlevered long-only spot; no spot short or borrow.
costs.execution_limitations: Reuse existing daily floating-quantity accounting; no historical L2, tick/lot/min-notional or minute capacity calibration. Daily close NAV does not include full intraday drawdown.

parameters.observation_terminal_action: Mark only; no artificial liquidation; preserve units/cash for continuing frozen plan

logic.entry: While cash, prior completed close strictly > mean of prior N completed daily closes * (1+band).
logic.exit: While long, prior completed close strictly < mean of prior N completed daily closes * (1-band). Equality/deadband preserves state.
logic.sizing: All available component cash buys spot at next 00:01 UTC minute open, after costs; no leverage, borrowing, periodic rebalance or transfers. USDT yield=0.

costs.impact: 0.5 * strictly previous20completedUTCdays sample log-close volatility * sqrt(reference order upper-bound cash budget or sell reference notional / previous20day quote ADV)
costs.funding_borrow: Not applicable to unlevered long-only spot; no spot short or borrow.
costs.execution_limitations: Reuse existing daily floating-quantity accounting; no historical L2, tick/lot/min-notional or minute capacity calibration. Daily close NAV does not include full intraday drawdown.

parameters.observation_terminal_action: Mark only; no artificial liquidation; preserve units/cash for continuing frozen plan
parameters.qualification: Partial shadow snapshot; minimum180days not reached; no long-run pass/fail inference

logic.allocation: Weights specify fractions of initial 2000 USDT capital, not target weights later. Sum actual already-size-costed component NAVs on exactly identical timestamps; no second scaling, averaging Sharpe or new component backtests.
logic.rebalance: No transfers or rebalancing; component absolute NAVs already reflect their specified initial capital and all actual size-dependent costs.

logic.allocation: Raw weights1/1 mean one whole pre-funded10000USDT BTCbook plus one whole10000USDT ETHbook,total20000. Add absoluteNAV once;do not normalize,multiply by50%again,transfer,reinvestorrebalance. Descriptiveinitialcapitalshares50/50 do not change raw weights.
logic.exposure: Each sourceentry fixed2000USDT from priorclose;both sleeves grossentrynotional4000whenactive,20%ofcombinedinitialcollateral. Eachcash/marginaccountisolated,nocross-marginnettingorborrow/cashyield.
logic.reuse: Recover source fullNAV from savedimmutable signedcash/quantity/entry state segments and actual axis prices,verify every originalNAVSHA. Never call source simulate,trade,funding or signal functions;no old result/status rewriting.
logic.alignment: Unionof source (actualns,eventtype) keys;preserveeventorder atsametime. Atmissingotherassetkey carry its last completed sourceNAVobservation,never interpolate or lookahead. Relativekey=(ts-commonstart)*16+eventcode avoids epochint64overflow.
logic.costs: Source1/2/3xexecutionandnegativefundingoutflowstress inherited in actualmatchedcostpaths;positivefundingincomeunscaled. Sum actual fees/funding once,no portfolio turnover fees since no new trade.
logic.risk: Recompute return/Sharpe/Calmar/wholeOOSDDfrom combinedfullcurve,not average components. Check both originalindependentmarginproxies separately;never offset a failed sleeve with othercash. MixedsampledNAV nottruetickmarkrisk.

logic.allocation: Raw weights1/1 mean one whole pre-funded10000USDT BTCbook plus one whole10000USDT ETHbook,total20000. Add absoluteNAV once;do not normalize,multiply by50%again,transfer,reinvestorrebalance. Descriptiveinitialcapitalshares50/50 do not change raw weights.
logic.exposure: Each sourceentry fixed2000USDT from priorclose;both sleeves grossentrynotional4000whenactive,20%ofcombinedinitialcollateral. Eachcash/marginaccountisolated,nocross-marginnettingorborrow/cashyield.
logic.reuse: Recover source fullNAV from savedimmutable signedcash/quantity/entry state segments and actual axis prices,verify every originalNAVSHA. Never call source simulate,trade,funding or signal functions;no old result/status rewriting.

logic.costs: Source1/2/3xexecutionandnegativefundingoutflowstress inherited in actualmatchedcostpaths;positivefundingincomeunscaled. Sum actual fees/funding once,no portfolio turnover fees since no new trade.
logic.risk: Recompute return/Sharpe/Calmar/wholeOOSDDfrom combinedfullcurve,not average components. Check both originalindependentmarginproxies separately;never offset a failed sleeve with othercash. MixedsampledNAV nottruetickmarkrisk.

logic.exit: While long, prior completed close strictly < mean of prior N completed daily closes * (1-band). Equality/deadband preserves state.
logic.sizing: All available component cash buys spot at next 00:01 UTC minute open, after costs; no leverage, borrowing, periodic rebalance or transfers. USDT yield=0.

costs.impact: 0.5 * strictly previous20completedUTCdays sample log-close volatility * sqrt(reference order upper-bound cash budget or sell reference notional / previous20day quote ADV)

costs.execution_limitations: Reuse existing daily floating-quantity accounting; no historical L2, tick/lot/min-notional or minute capacity calibration. Daily close NAV does not include full intraday drawdown.

logic.signal: At daily decision i,priorcompletedperpetualROC=C[i-1]/C[i-1-L]-1. Flat enterslong iff ROC>H,short iff ROC<-H. Inside or on entrybands,existinglong persists strictly while ROC>-E;existingshort persists strictly while ROC<E. Long exits at ROC<=-E;short exits at ROC>=E. Crossing opposite strict fullentryband closesold then opensopposite at00:01. E<=H,at exact +/-H no newentry. State is actualsignedquantity,no unpublishedprice/funding input.
logic.execution: At next00:01nativeperpetualOPEN,if desired direction differs,close old signed position first then enter desired if nonzero. Same direction retains actual quantity,no daily resizing. Quantity for a new entry=floor(2000USDT/priorcompletedC/lot)*lot times direction,not sized from future OPEN,NAV or unpublished funding.
logic.allocation: Independent10000USDT collateral account per config. Fixed raw entry notional20% of initial collateral=2000USDT;pricegap/lot can change actual entry percentage. At most one signedlinearUSDTperp position;entrynotional<=postfeecollateral (1xcap). No borrowingunderlying,spotshort,leveragefundingloan,transfer or cashyield;not normalized weights.
logic.ledger: Opening debitsfeeonly;unrealizedPnL=q*(price-entryexecution). Closing realizes signedq*(exitexecution-entryexecution) and paysfee. Notional is not debited as spot cash.
